bio.title: Jheyson Saavedra
bio.description: I ask hard questions for a living — some with SQL, some without. I'm a data analyst trained in Philosophy, which means I care about *why* the numbers say what they say, not just what they show.
bio.current: Previously, I helped reduce fraud exposure by 83% at Holafly, built dashboards with BigQuery and Looker Studio, and automated reporting workflows. Now I'm finishing my Philosophy degree at Universidad del Atlántico and looking for my next role.
bio.personal: I read, listen to music, and build tools like Clipio — a clipboard manager for browsers.
